definitions.explanation: A short traditional Japanese coat without the folded-back lapels of a haori. Today it usually means the padded cotton jacket worn over clothes at home in winter; it is also the livery coat of workmen and festival-goers, much like a {法被|はっぴ}.

examples.japanese: {半纏|はんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{羽織|はお}る→羽織る：13901_haoru⟧。

examples.english: In winter I wear a padded jacket at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦{綿入|わたい}れ→綿入れ：21191_wataire⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{半纏|はんてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: The cotton-padded hanten my grandmother made me keeps me warm even without the heating on.

notes:
Also written {袢纏|はんてん}. A homely, old-fashioned garment, associated with winters in unheated Japanese houses and with the ⟦{炬燵|こたつ}→炬燵：05070_kotatsu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{綿入|わたい}れ→綿入れ：21191_wataire⟧{半纏|はんてん}: a cotton-padded hanten
- {印半纏|しるしばんてん}: a livery coat with the employer's crest
- {半纏|はんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{羽織|はお}る→羽織る：13901_haoru⟧: to throw on a hanten
